name: Minefield Classic
description: The classic mine-clearing puzzle, one click away in your toolbar. Three board sizes, safe first click, right-click flags, chording on numbers, a stopwatch and a personal best time per difficulty. An unfinished board is kept locally so you can come back to it, and the clock pauses while the popup is closed. No network access and nothing leaves your computer.

browser_action.default_title: Minefield Classic — The board game that ate the nineties
